page_title: BOU 3-0 FUL | Bournemouth v Fulham 26/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Tim Robinson has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Tim Robinson blows for a foul.
90+3' 3 - 0 What a beauty from just outside the box! Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power inside the right post.
90+3' David Brooks (Bournemouth) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
90+1' David Brooks (Bournemouth) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Bernd Leno is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
88' Here comes a substitution. David Brooks (Bournemouth) is brought on as a substitute for Marcus Tavernier.
85' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) makes a strong challenge and Tim Robinson blows for a foul.
83' Substitution. Tom Cairney leaves the pitch and is replaced by Sasa Lukic (Fulham).
83' Marco Silva decides to make a substitution. Antonee Robinson will be replaced by Fode Ballo-Toure (Fulham).
83' Substitution. Carlos Vinicius (Fulham) replaces Andreas Pereira.

82' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
77' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
75' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
73' Marco Silva has decided to substitute Bobby De Cordova-Reid and he is replaced by Harry Wilson (Fulham).
73' Substitution. Kenny Tete makes way for Timothy Castagne (Fulham).
73' Here is a change. Justin Kluivert is going off and Andoni Iraola gives the last tactical orders to Philip Billing (Bournemouth).
72' Substitution. Antoine Semenyo will be replaced by Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth).
72' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Antonee Robinson (Fulham).
70' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
68' Fulham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
67' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
66' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
63' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is given a yellow card.
62' 2 - 0 Goal! Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) slams home the penalty with a precise low shot into the bottom right corner.
62' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
62' The foul by Bernd Leno (Fulham) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Tim Robinson.
61' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) was too forceful with his tackle and Tim Robinson interrupted the game to signal a free kick. A penalty is given to Bournemouth!
59' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes the free kick from distance, but his attempt fails to worry the goalkeeper.
57' Calvin Bassey (Fulham) serves up a nice cross, but Neto punches the ball away.
56' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
52' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Neto, who smothers the ball.
50' A pass from Antonee Robinson (Fulham) is intercepted by Neto and the move breaks down.
50' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
47' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
46' Tim Robinson blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
45+2' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

44' 1 - 0 Goal! Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Alex Scott inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball low into the middle of the goal. 1:0.
42' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
39' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
38' The corner from Alex Scott (Bournemouth) is intercepted by the defence.
38' The defender did brilliantly to block the long-range effort from Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth). The ball is out of play. Bournemouth win a corner kick.
38' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
37' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Bernd Leno intercepts the ball.
35' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bournemouth comes to nothing.
33' Tim Robinson couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Calvin Bassey (Fulham) and blew his whistle.
32' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) launches a cross from the corner, but Bernd Leno is alert to thwart the effort.

31' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth have been awarded a corner kick.

31' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
27' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
26' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
22' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
19' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) takes the corner with a short pass.
18' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Fulham have a corner.

17' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
16' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
14' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Kenny Tete (Fulham) but poses no threat.
12' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

12' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bournemouth.
11' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
11' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) takes a short corner kick.

11' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bournemouth.
10' Kenny Tete (Fulham) cracks a shot goalwards from the edge of the box, but his radar is off and it sails well wide of the left post.
9' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
9' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) sends a cross into the box, but Bernd Leno comes off his line to gather the ball.
8' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
7' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
7' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) will take a corner kick.
6' A lofted cross from Alex Iwobi (Fulham) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball goes out of play. Fulham are awarded a corner kick.
4' Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul after Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) hacks down one of his opponents.
2' The game is interrupted. Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
1' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) brings an opponent down and Tim Robinson interrupts the game.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bournemouth will have the kick-off.
Tim Robinson was nominated as the referee for this game.
